name: neon_get_current_user
description: Get the current authenticated Neon user account details including name, email, and account ID.

name: neon_check_api_key
description: Validate that the NEON_API_KEY in .env is working and has the correct permissions.

name: neon_list_api_keys
description: List all Neon API keys for the current account.

name: neon_create_api_key
description: Create a new Neon API key with a given name.

key_name.description: Name for the new API key

name: neon_revoke_api_key
description: Revoke and delete a Neon API key by its ID.

key_id.description: ID of the API key to revoke

name: neon_list_organizations
description: List all organizations the current Neon account belongs to.

name: neon_list_projects
description: List all Neon projects in the account with optional search and pagination.

name: neon_create_project
description: Create a new Neon project with a specified name, region, and PostgreSQL version.

name: neon_delete_project
description: Permanently delete a Neon project and all its branches, databases, and data.

name: neon_describe_project
description: Get full details for a Neon project including all branches and endpoints in one call.

name: neon_update_project
description: Update a Neon project name or history retention period.

name: neon_get_project_operations
description: List recent operations (branch creations, deployments, etc.) on a Neon project.

name: neon_get_project_consumption
description: Get compute and storage consumption history for a Neon project.

name: neon_get_project_quotas
description: Get the default endpoint settings and quotas for a Neon project.

name: neon_list_shared_projects
description: List all Neon projects that have been shared with the current user.

name: neon_share_project
description: Share a Neon project with another user by email.

name: neon_revoke_project_share
description: Remove a user's access to a shared Neon project.

name: neon_list_project_shares
description: List all users who have access to a Neon project.

name: neon_list_branches
description: List all branches in a Neon project with their IDs, names, and status.

name: neon_create_branch
description: Create a new Neon branch from the primary branch or a specific parent, optionally at a specific timestamp for point-in-time recovery.

name: neon_delete_branch
description: Delete a Neon branch and its endpoint. Cannot delete the primary branch.

name: neon_get_branch_details
description: Get details for a specific Neon branch including state and timestamps.

name: neon_describe_branch
description: Get a full description of a Neon branch including its endpoints, databases, and roles in a single call.

name: neon_update_branch
description: Rename a Neon branch.

name: neon_reset_from_parent
description: Reset a Neon branch back to the state of its parent branch (discard all changes on the branch).

name: neon_restore_branch_to_timestamp
description: Create a new Neon branch at a specific point in time for point-in-time recovery (PITR).

name: neon_set_branch_as_primary
description: Promote a Neon branch to become the primary branch of the project.

name: neon_get_branch_schema_diff
description: Compare the schema of a branch against another branch to see what changed.

name: neon_list_branch_endpoints
description: List all compute endpoints specifically attached to a given Neon branch.

name: neon_get_branch_history
description: Get the full operation history and timeline for a specific Neon branch.

name: neon_clone_branch
description: Create a copy of a Neon branch under a new name, optionally with a new read-write endpoint.

name: neon_list_databases
description: List all databases on a specific Neon branch.

name: neon_create_database
description: Create a new database on a Neon branch.

name: neon_delete_database
description: Delete a database from a Neon branch.

name: neon_get_database_size
description: Get the total disk size of the current database in bytes and human-readable format.

name: neon_get_database_tables
description: List all tables in the database with their total size, table size, and index size sorted by largest first.

name: neon_describe_table_schema
description: Get all columns, data types, nullability, and defaults for a specific table.

name: neon_vacuum_database
description: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on the database to reclaim storage and update statistics.

name: neon_analyze_database
description: Run ANALYZE VERBOSE to update all table statistics used by the query planner.

name: neon_get_database_locks
description: Show all queries currently waiting on locks in the database.

name: neon_kill_database_query
description: Forcefully terminate a running query by its process ID (PID).

name: neon_get_database_activity
description: Show all currently active (non-idle) queries with state, user, and duration.

name: neon_run_sql
description: Execute any SQL statement against a Neon database and return the results.

name: neon_run_sql_transaction
description: Execute multiple SQL statements as a single atomic transaction with BEGIN/COMMIT.

statements.description: Array of SQL statements to run in a transaction

name: neon_explain_sql_statement
description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a SQL query to get the actual execution plan with real timings.

name: neon_list_slow_queries
description: List the slowest queries by average execution time from pg_stat_statements.

name: neon_detect_missing_indexes
description: Find tables with high sequential scan counts that likely need indexes added.

name: neon_get_index_usage
description: Show how frequently each index is being used (scan counts and rows fetched).

name: neon_get_table_bloat
description: Find tables with high dead tuple counts that need VACUUM to reclaim space.

name: neon_analyze_deadlocks
description: Identify queries that are currently blocked or causing deadlocks.

name: neon_run_sql_batch
description: Execute multiple SQL statements sequentially and return all results. Optionally stops on first error.

statements.description: Array of SQL statements to run

name: neon_get_table_row_counts
description: Get estimated or exact row counts for all tables in a schema, sorted by largest first.

exact.description: Run exact COUNT(*) — slow on large tables (default false)

name: neon_get_long_running_queries
description: Find all queries that have been running longer than a given number of seconds.

name: neon_cancel_query
description: Send a cancellation signal to a running query by PID. Softer than terminate — lets the query finish its current operation.

name: neon_get_query_plan
description: Get the EXPLAIN query plan without actually executing the query.

format.description: Output format: TEXT or JSON (default TEXT)

name: neon_reset_query_stats
description: Reset all pg_stat_statements counters to start fresh performance monitoring.

name: neon_list_slow_queries_by_calls
description: List the most frequently called queries (by call count, not slowness) from pg_stat_statements.

name: neon_search_schema
description: Search across all table names and column names in the database for a keyword.

search_term.description: Term to search for in table and column names

name: neon_get_table_statistics
description: Get detailed per-table statistics from pg_stat_user_tables including scan counts, inserts, updates, and vacuum history.

table_name.description: Specific table name (optional — returns all if omitted)

name: neon_get_all_settings
description: List PostgreSQL server settings, optionally filtered by a keyword.

filter.description: Filter settings by name or description

name: neon_get_replication_slots
description: List all PostgreSQL replication slots and their status.

name: neon_get_installed_extensions
description: List all PostgreSQL extensions currently installed in the database with their version and schema.

name: neon_get_table_ddl
description: Generate the CREATE TABLE DDL statement for a specific table — useful for documenting or recreating schemas.

name: neon_get_full_schema_dump
description: Generate CREATE TABLE DDL for all tables in a schema — full schema export.

name: neon_list_indexes
description: List all indexes in a schema or on a specific table with their definitions and sizes.

name: neon_list_enums
description: List all custom enum types in the database with their possible values.

name: neon_list_functions
description: List all stored functions and procedures in a schema with their return types and arguments.

name: neon_get_function_definition
description: Get the full source code and definition of a stored function or procedure.

name: neon_list_triggers
description: List all triggers on a schema or specific table with their event types and action statements.

name: neon_list_views
description: List all views and materialized views in a schema with their definitions.

name: neon_list_constraints
description: List all constraints (PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE, CHECK) on a table or schema.

name: neon_get_table_dependencies
description: Show what views, materialized views, and other objects depend on a given table.

name: neon_get_foreign_keys
description: List all foreign key relationships in a schema or for a specific table showing from/to columns.

name: neon_get_sequences
description: List all PostgreSQL sequences (auto-increment generators) with their current values and limits.

name: neon_list_schemas
description: List all schemas in the database (excluding system schemas).

name: neon_create_index
description: Create an index on a table using a specified method (btree, hash, gin, gist). Supports unique and partial indexes.

method.description: btree, hash, gin, gist, brin (default btree)

name: neon_drop_index
description: Drop an existing index, optionally running CONCURRENTLY to avoid locking.

name: neon_create_enum
description: Create a new custom PostgreSQL enum type with a set of allowed values.

name: neon_add_enum_value
description: Add a new value to an existing PostgreSQL enum type, optionally positioning it after/before another value.

name: neon_create_view
description: Create a database view or replace an existing view with a new SQL query definition.

sql_query.description: SQL SELECT query for the view

name: neon_drop_view
description: Drop a view or materialized view. Optionally cascade to drop dependent objects.

name: neon_refresh_materialized_view
description: Refresh a materialized view to update it with the latest data from its underlying query.

name: neon_create_schema
description: Create a new PostgreSQL schema (namespace) in the database, optionally assigning an owner.

name: neon_add_column
description: Add a new column to an existing table with type, nullability, and optional default value.

data_type.description: PostgreSQL data type (e.g. text, integer, uuid)

name: neon_drop_column
description: Drop a column from a table. Optionally CASCADE to drop dependent views/constraints.

name: neon_alter_column_type
description: Change the data type of an existing column. Use the USING clause for type conversion expressions.

name: neon_set_column_default
description: Set or drop the default value for a column. Pass null as default_value to drop the default.

default_value.description: Default value expression, or null to drop

name: neon_set_column_not_null
description: Add or remove the NOT NULL constraint on a column.

not_null.description: true to add NOT NULL, false to drop it

name: neon_rename_table
description: Rename a table to a new name.

name: neon_rename_column
description: Rename a column in a table.

name: neon_create_table
description: Create a new table with a list of column definitions including types, nullability, defaults, and primary keys.

columns.description: Array of column objects: {name, type, not_null?, default?, primary_key?, unique?, references?}

name: neon_drop_table
description: Drop a table. Optionally CASCADE to also drop dependent views and foreign keys.

name: neon_truncate_table
description: Remove all rows from a table quickly. Optionally restart identity sequences and cascade to related tables.

name: neon_add_foreign_key
description: Add a FOREIGN KEY constraint to a table referencing another table with configurable ON DELETE/UPDATE actions.

on_delete.description: NO ACTION, CASCADE, SET NULL, RESTRICT

name: neon_drop_constraint
description: Drop a named constraint (FK, UNIQUE, CHECK) from a table.

name: neon_count_rows
description: Get the exact row count for a table, optionally with a WHERE filter.

name: neon_select_rows
description: SELECT rows from a table with optional columns, WHERE filter, ORDER BY, LIMIT, and OFFSET.

name: neon_insert_row
description: Insert a single row into a table from a data object and return the inserted row.

data.description: Key-value object of column names to values

name: neon_update_rows
description: Update rows in a table matching a WHERE clause with new values. WHERE clause is required for safety.

where.description: Required WHERE clause (use 1=1 to update all rows)

name: neon_delete_rows
description: Delete rows from a table matching a WHERE clause. WHERE is required for safety — use '1=1' to delete all.

name: neon_upsert_rows
description: Insert a row or update it if it conflicts on specified columns (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE).

data.description: Row data to insert or update

update_columns.description: Columns to update on conflict (defaults to all non-conflict columns)

name: neon_get_sample_rows
description: Get a random sample of rows from a table using TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM for fast random access.

name: neon_export_table_csv
description: Export table rows as CSV-formatted text with optional WHERE filter and row limit.

name: neon_copy_table_data
description: Copy rows from one table into another using INSERT ... SELECT. Skips conflicts.

name: neon_enable_pgvector
description: Enable the pgvector extension in the database for AI embedding and similarity search support.

name: neon_create_vector_table
description: Create a table with a vector embedding column, metadata jsonb, and timestamps — ready for pgvector similarity search.

dimensions.description: Embedding dimensions: 1536 for OpenAI, 768 for others (default 1536)

name: neon_create_vector_index
description: Create an HNSW or IVFFlat index on a vector column for fast approximate nearest-neighbor search.

name: neon_insert_embedding
description: Insert a single vector embedding with its content and metadata into a pgvector table.

embedding.description: Float array of the embedding vector

name: neon_bulk_insert_embeddings
description: Insert multiple vector embeddings in a single batch INSERT for efficient RAG data loading.

name: neon_similarity_search_cosine
description: Find the most similar vectors using cosine similarity (1 - cosine distance). Returns content, similarity score, and metadata.

query_embedding.description: The query vector to search against

name: neon_similarity_search_l2
description: Find the most similar vectors using L2 (Euclidean) distance — lower distance means more similar.

name: neon_list_vector_tables
description: Find all tables in the database that have a vector column (pgvector enabled tables).

name: neon_enable_full_text_search
description: Enable pg_trgm and unaccent extensions for full-text and trigram fuzzy search support.

name: neon_create_fts_index
description: Create a GIN index on one or more text columns to enable fast full-text search with tsvector.

columns.description: Text columns to include in the FTS index

name: neon_full_text_search
description: Search text columns using PostgreSQL full-text search with ranked results. Uses plainto_tsquery.

name: neon_trigram_search
description: Fuzzy search using pg_trgm trigram similarity — tolerates typos and partial matches.

name: neon_list_all_db_roles
description: List all PostgreSQL database roles with their attributes (superuser, login, replication, etc.).

name: neon_list_role_privileges
description: Show all table privileges granted to a specific database role in a schema.

name: neon_grant_table_access
description: GRANT specific privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on a table to a role.

name: neon_revoke_table_access
description: REVOKE privileges on a table from a role.

name: neon_grant_schema_access
description: GRANT USAGE on a schema to a role, optionally also granting SELECT on all tables within it.

also_grant_tables.description: Also GRANT SELECT on all tables (default false)

name: neon_create_readonly_role
description: Create a read-only database role with SELECT access to one or more schemas, including future tables.

name: neon_get_rls_policies
description: List all Row Level Security policies on a table or schema.

name: neon_create_rls_policy
description: Create a Row Level Security policy on a table controlling which rows a role can see or modify.

name: neon_drop_rls_policy
description: Drop a Row Level Security policy from a table.

name: neon_enable_rls
description: Enable Row Level Security on a table. Use FORCE to apply to table owner as well.

force.description: Apply RLS to table owner too

name: neon_disable_rls
description: Disable Row Level Security on a table.

name: neon_get_database_stats
description: Get comprehensive database statistics from pg_stat_database including connections, commits, cache hits, and temp files.

name: neon_get_table_io_stats
description: Show heap and index I/O statistics per table — reveals cache hit ratios at the table level.

name: neon_get_vacuum_stats
description: Show vacuum and analyze history for all tables with dead tuple counts. Identifies tables needing maintenance.

name: neon_get_transaction_id_age
description: Check XID (transaction ID) age for all databases — critical for detecting wraparound risk before it causes a database shutdown.

name: neon_check_unused_indexes
description: Find indexes that have never been used (zero scans since last stats reset) — candidates for removal to save space.

name: neon_get_temp_file_usage
description: Show temp file generation stats — high numbers indicate work_mem is too low and queries are spilling to disk.

name: neon_get_wait_events
description: Show what backends and queries are currently waiting on (locks, I/O, network, etc.).

name: neon_get_index_health
description: Comprehensive index health report showing size, scan count, and health status (UNUSED, LOW, OK) for all non-primary indexes.

name: neon_get_account_consumption
description: Get account-level Neon resource consumption across all projects with optional date range and granularity.

name: neon_list_projects_by_consumption
description: List all Neon projects ranked by compute time and storage usage — useful for cost optimization.

name: neon_get_connection_string
description: Retrieve an authenticated PostgreSQL connection URI from Neon; secret values are redacted at the Toolkit output boundary.

name: neon_get_connection_uri
description: Retrieve an authenticated PostgreSQL connection URI from Neon; secret values are redacted at the Toolkit output boundary.

name: neon_test_connection
description: Test that the Neon database connection works by running a simple SELECT with version and server time.

name: neon_list_endpoints
description: List all compute endpoints in a Neon project.

name: neon_create_endpoint
description: Create a new compute endpoint for a Neon branch with configurable autoscaling CUs.

name: neon_delete_endpoint
description: Delete a compute endpoint from a Neon project.

name: neon_update_endpoint
description: Update endpoint autoscaling limits and suspend timeout settings.

name: neon_start_endpoint
description: Start a suspended Neon compute endpoint.

name: neon_suspend_endpoint
description: Suspend a running Neon compute endpoint to stop incurring compute costs.

name: neon_restart_endpoint
description: Restart a Neon compute endpoint.

name: neon_set_endpoint_autoscaling
description: Set the minimum and maximum compute units for endpoint autoscaling.

name: neon_set_endpoint_pooling
description: Enable or disable connection pooling on an endpoint and set the pooling mode (transaction or session).

name: neon_list_roles
description: List all Neon-managed roles on a branch (not DB-level roles — use neon_list_all_db_roles for those).

name: neon_create_role
description: Create a new Neon role on a branch.

name: neon_delete_role
description: Delete a Neon role from a branch.

name: neon_reset_role_password
description: Reset (rotate) the password for a Neon role on a branch.

name: neon_list_extensions
description: List all available PostgreSQL extensions in the database, showing which are installed.

name: neon_enable_extension
description: Install a PostgreSQL extension in the database using CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS.

extension_name.description: Extension name e.g. uuid-ossp, pg_trgm, vector

name: neon_disable_extension
description: Remove an installed PostgreSQL extension using DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS.

name: neon_prepare_database_migration
description: Create a temporary migration test branch so migrations can be tested before applying to main.

name: neon_complete_database_migration
description: Apply or discard a migration that was tested on a migration branch. Set apply=true to merge, false to discard.

apply.description: true to apply migration, false to discard

name: neon_deploy_schema
description: Run a SQL schema script directly against a Neon database (CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, etc.).

sql_content.description: Full SQL schema script to execute

name: neon_verify_schema
description: Verify that all required tables exist in the database. Returns missing tables.

required_tables.description: List of table names that must exist

name: neon_get_cache_hit_ratio
description: Get the buffer cache hit ratio for the database — should be above 99% for healthy performance.

name: neon_get_connection_stats
description: Show max connections, currently used connections, and available connections.

name: neon_list_webhooks
description: List all webhooks configured on a Neon project for event notifications.

name: neon_create_webhook
description: Create a webhook to receive Neon events (branch created, database created, etc.) at a URL.

name: neon_delete_webhook
description: Delete a webhook from a Neon project.

name: neon_get_performance_insights
description: Get a combined performance snapshot including slow queries, index usage, and table sizes.

name: neon_get_cost_breakdown
description: Get consumption event history for a project to analyze what is driving compute and storage costs.

name: neon_get_billing_history
description: Get the full account-level billing and consumption history across all Neon projects.

name: neon_list_read_replicas
description: List all read-only replica endpoints for a Neon project.

name: neon_create_read_replica
description: Create a read-only replica endpoint for a Neon branch to offload read queries.

name: neon_enable_ip_allowlist
description: Restrict database access to specific IP addresses for enhanced security.

ips.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR blocks

name: neon_get_ip_allowlist
description: Get the current IP allowlist configuration for a Neon project.

name: neon_rotate_credentials
description: Reset (rotate) the password for a specific role — useful for periodic credential rotation.

name: neon_provision_neon_auth
description: Set up the auth schema in a Neon database for use with Neon Auth integration.

name: neon_get_connection_pooler_config
description: Get the current connection pooler (PgBouncer) configuration for an endpoint.

name: neon_update_connection_pooler_config
description: Enable or disable connection pooling and set the mode on a specific endpoint.

name: neon_suggest_indexes
description: Analyze table scan patterns and suggest where indexes may improve query performance.

name: neon_setup_rad_database
description: Create a complete Neon project with a database and return the connection string — one-call full setup.

name: neon_create_project_for_rad
description: Alias for neon_setup_rad_database — create a complete Neon project with connection string in one call.

name: neon_full_health_report
description: SUPER TOOL: Run a comprehensive database health check covering cache hit ratio, connections, slow queries, table bloat, vacuum status, unused indexes, and XID wraparound risk — all in one call.

name: neon_safe_migration
description: SUPER TOOL: Safely test a SQL migration on a temporary branch first — if it succeeds, optionally apply it to the real branch. Automatically cleans up the test branch whether the migration succeeds or fails.

branch_id.description: Target branch to migrate (defaults to primary)

migration_sql.description: SQL migration statements to test and apply

validate_sql.description: Optional SQL to validate after migration

auto_apply.description: Apply to target branch if test passes (default false)

name: neon_setup_rag_schema
description: SUPER TOOL: One-call RAG/vector search database setup — enables pgvector, creates the embeddings table, cosine HNSW index, GIN metadata index, and returns the connection string ready to use.

name: neon_connection_string_all_formats
description: SUPER TOOL: Get the Neon connection string in every format at once — postgres URL, psql, Node.js Neon serverless, Prisma schema, Drizzle ORM, Python asyncpg/psycopg2, Go, and .env format.

name: neon_backup_create
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a named point-in-time backup branch with no compute endpoint — pure storage snapshot that costs nothing to keep running. Use neon_clone_branch to restore.

name: neon_generate_typescript_types
description: SUPER TOOL: Query the database schema and generate TypeScript interface definitions for all tables — saves hours of manual type writing.

schema.description: Schema to generate types for (default public)

include_comments.description: Include column defaults as comments (default true)

name: neon_find_missing_indexes
description: SUPER TOOL: Comprehensive analysis of tables with high sequential scan counts compared to index scans — identifies the highest-impact indexing opportunities with severity ratings.

name: neon_performance_tuning_report
description: SUPER TOOL: Complete performance analysis in a single call — slowest queries, missing indexes, unused indexes, table bloat, cache hit ratio, temp file usage, wait events, largest tables, and XID wraparound risk with actionable next steps.

name: neon_update_ip_allowlist
description: Set the IP allowlist for a Neon project (replaces entire list).

name: neon_add_ip_to_allowlist
description: Add a single IP or CIDR range to the Neon project IP allowlist.

ip.description: IP address or CIDR range e.g. 192.168.1.1/32

name: neon_remove_ip_from_allowlist
description: Remove a specific IP or CIDR range from the Neon project IP allowlist.

name: neon_enable_logical_replication
description: Enable logical replication for a Neon project (required for CDC/replication tools like Debezium, Airbyte).

name: neon_list_replication_slots
description: List PostgreSQL logical replication slots in a Neon database.

name: neon_create_replication_slot
description: Create a logical replication slot in a Neon database.

name: neon_drop_replication_slot
description: Drop a logical replication slot from a Neon database.

name: neon_list_publications
description: List PostgreSQL publications in a Neon database (used for logical replication).

name: neon_create_publication
description: Create a PostgreSQL publication for logical replication in a Neon database.

name: neon_drop_publication
description: Drop a PostgreSQL publication from a Neon database.

name: neon_get_org_billing
description: Get billing information for a Neon organization.

name: neon_list_org_projects
description: List all projects in a Neon organization.

name: neon_list_org_members
description: List members of a Neon organization.

name: neon_get_org_consumption
description: Get resource consumption statistics for a Neon organization.

name: neon_get_auth_config
description: Get the Neon Auth (JWT) configuration for a project.

name: neon_update_auth_config
description: Configure Neon Auth — set JWKS URL and role names for JWT-based authentication.

name: neon_project_security_audit
description: SUPER TOOL: Project security audit — IP allowlist status, logical replication, RLS coverage, and role count in one call.
